captions.detailed: A compact electronic camcorder styled in a dark matte finish. It features a rectangular main body, a cylindrical front lens assembly with a rotating zoom collar, a rear-mounted viewing eyecup, and a rectangular side display panel. The side display panel pivots outward on a vertical revolute hinge, while a small battery-release latch is positioned near the back of the camera body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact camcorder with a rectangular main body, a front-facing zoom lens collar, a rear eyecup, and a side-mounted display panel. Ensure the display panel can rotate outward on a vertical hinge, the front zoom collar rotates continuously around the lens axis, and a small battery latch at the back pivots on its own joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a rounded box primitive and add a top accessory shoe using a smaller box. Create the front camera lens assembly by combining concentric cylinders for the lens barrel and zoom collar, attaching them to the body with a continuous joint. Model the side display panel as a thin box and connect it to the main body via a revolute joint. Finally, model the rear eyecup and a small rectangular battery latch, attaching the latch with a revolute joint.
